personalities.name: You’re TRUE TO YOU
personalities.description: You lead with clarity and grace. You do not need noise to make an impact. Your presence is enough. Your cocktail is the Lavender Lemon Spritz: True Vodka, lavender, and lemon. Light, intentional, and quietly unforgettable.

personalities.name: You’re INNER GLOW
personalities.description: You move through the world with warmth, color, and emotional electricity. You remind people that joy can be a form of wisdom. Your cocktail is the Hibiscus Limeade: tequila, hibiscus, and lime. Bright, expressive, and made to be felt.

personalities.name: You’re SOUL PROOF
personalities.description: You are grounded, layered, and stronger than the room realizes at first glance. You carry sweetness, spice, and experience in equal measure. Your cocktail is the Frosted Ginger Apple: bourbon or brandy, apple, ginger, lemon, and spices. Deep, steady, and impossible to fake.

questions.label: Trust the Process
questions.text: "Trust the Process" — what does that mean to you tonight?

answers.content: Letting go and letting things flow
Following the feeling and lighting up the room
Standing on what I’ve survived and built
Still becoming — but ready to choose myself

questions.label: Learning to Love
questions.text: The part of yourself you’re learning to love most is:

answers.content: My softness, intuition, and sensitivity
My radiance, joy, and bold energy
My depth, resilience, and complexity
All of it — it’s a process

questions.label: Room Energy
questions.text: When you walk into a room, what do you hope people feel from you?

answers.content: Calm, clarity, and ease
Warmth, color, and magnetic energy
Strength, wisdom, and realness
Permission to be fully themselves

questions.label: Guidance
questions.text: What kind of guidance do you want from GEMINI NEAR ME® tonight?

answers.content: A gentle reflection that helps me breathe
A spark that lifts my mood and opens my heart
A grounded truth I can actually carry with me
The sign I didn’t know I needed

questions.label: Self Love Language
questions.text: Your love language to yourself right now is:

answers.content: Peace, space, and a softer pace
Celebration, movement, and saying yes to life
Loyalty, boundaries, and choosing what’s real
Patience while I evolve

questions.label: Stepping Into
questions.text: What’s the version of yourself you’re stepping into tonight?

answers.content: Open, clear, and in full bloom
Bold, alive, and unstoppable
Grounded, whole, and truly myself
Still becoming — and that’s okay
